channel.title: Prop Desk News
channel.description: Prop firm rule changes, codes and sales, checked against each firm's own pages.

item.description: New "Rapid" model with two paths. Rapid Daily: daily rewards, daily loss limit ($500 / $1,000 / $1,250), no consistency, buffer of starting balance + max…

item.title: Take Profit Trader extends NOFEE50 by 48 hours, now ending Nov 11
item.description: NOFEE50 (Early Black Friday, 50% off for life + no activation fee) extended 48 hours: now ends Wed Nov 11, 11:59 PM ET (FAQ still says Nov 9).

item.title: ProjectX is now Topstep only: the 17 prop firms that lost it
item.description: ProjectX is now Topstep only: projectx.com redirects to Topstep's TopstepX page, and the branded ProjectX logins for 17 other firms no longer exist…

item.title: Goat Funded Futures Flex accounts: max contracts now scale with profit
item.description: Flex funded accounts: max contracts now scale with profit. 50K: 2 minis / 20 micros under $1,000 profit, 3 / 30 from $1,000, max 4 / 40 from $2,000.

item.title: IQ Capital launches Flex futures plan with payouts every 5 days
item.description: New futures plan "Flex": payouts every 5 days; 50K $3,000 target, $2,000 EOD drawdown, $1,300 soft DLL ($139 on the 85% sale).

item.title: Goat Funded Futures puts every plan on a 1-minute hold rule
item.description: Every plan now uses one "1 minute rule" (from Mon Nov 9): at each payout request and at eval pass, at least 70% of closed trades and 70% of net profit…

item.title: FuturesElite explains how funded traders move to live capital
item.description: Live Trading Program. Risk team picks who goes live (usually after 4th consecutive payout).

item.title: Elite Trader Funding's NOV75 takes 75% off evaluations until Nov 13
item.description: New sale NOV75: 75% off every month until you pass or cancel, any non-Fast Track evaluation (excludes Fast Track and DTF), ends Fri Nov 13, 11:59 PM ET

item.title: BluSky Trading sets Propel evaluation consistency at 55%
item.description: Propel evaluation consistency now 55% (firm's own video says it was 34%)

item.title: Lucid's live accounts: $0 start, EOD drawdown, sim accounts close
item.description: New Live Structure. Live starts at $0 balance with EOD drawdown and no DLL; all sim accounts close when moved live.

item.title: Funded Futures Family cuts Velocity add-on prices to $29 and $30
item.description: Velocity add-on prices cut: Daily Payout +$39 → +$29, EOD drawdown (vs intraday trailing) +$39 → +$30 (USD).

item.description: Accelerate 50K accounts bought on or after Oct 30, 2026 have a $500 max on every payout and need $1,500 in new profit before each payout.

item.title: Traders Launch closes evaluations after 7 days without a trade
item.description: evaluations with no trade for 7 days in a row are breached (closed, can't be reopened); funded accounts are turned off instead and can be reactivated.

item.title: Goat, FundedNext Futures and Top One Trader offer multi-account discounts
item.description: Bundle discounts: Goat GOAT Daily 2/3/5 accounts 4/6/10% off; FundedNext Futures 5th account 10% off, 10th 20%.

item.title: FundingPips Labs 004: 25K 1-Step drop at $99 or $199, no trailing drawdown
item.description: Labs 004 drop (limited time): 25K 1-Step, 6% target, no trailing drawdown, no consistency rule, 80% split, unlimited daily reward requests from day one…

item.title: FTMO Futures updates Growth drawdown on its 100K and 150K accounts
item.description: Growth Max Drawdown (EOD trailing) now $3,000 on the 100K and $4,500 on the 150K, both tagged "Updated" on FTMO's rules page (modified Nov 5).

item.title: PropShopTrader's NOV26 sale: 40% off challenges until Nov 30
item.description: NOV26 now dated: 40% off assessments and challenges, 25% off Direct and Instant, all four markets, ends Nov 30, 2026

item.title: FTM Perps (ftmperps.com): Funded Trader Markets' new 24/7 perps program
